content: Ek bar ekzon Foroši netaye Isare hitar górot hánar dawat diye. He din aššilde dórmor din, ar manušzone kub bala gori Isar uzu kiyal raikke.
Ar so, fula biyaram oiyede hendilla ekzon ošuikka manuš Isar sarme aišše.
Toi Isaye dórmiyo alem okkol edde Foroši okkolore fusar goredde,

content.text: "Musar ain mozin dórmor din honokiyore aram goro ki ejazot ase, naki nai?"

content: Kintu hitara nizam oi taikke. Hetunot Isaye he manušware hate dori aram gori bidai diye.
Tarbade Isaye he dórmiyo neta okkolore hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara honokiyor fũwa ba goru zodi kuwat fori zagoi, dórmor din oile o ki tũwara hitarare hehon hentu tuli no lo ne?"

content: Kintu hitara hiyanor zuwab o di no fare.
Ar dawatot aišše de manuš okkole ijjotor zaga ken gori basi lor deki, Isaye hitarare šikka dibolla ekkan kahani hoiye:

content.text: "Zehon honokiye tũware melat dawat de, hetunot tũi hánar ṭebilor uworor zagat zai no boiššogoi. Kiyollahoile oitfare tũwattuwaro aro ijjotdar honokiyore heṛe dawat diya oiye.
Ze tũware edde hibare dawat diye hiba ai zodi tũware ho, ei zaga iyan ubare do, hetunot to tũi šorom faiba. Ar tũwattu beggunottuwaro nisor zagat zai bowagoi foribo.

Tũware honokiye dawat dile, bolke beggunottuwaro nisor zagat zai boiyo. Hen oile dawat diyede góror malike aiyore tũware hoibo, 'Bondu aro bala zagat zai boyogoi.' Hetunot oinno meheman okkolor sarme tũi ijjotta oiba.
Kiyollahoile ze nizore usol gore hitare niso gora oibo, ar ze nizore niso gore hitare usol gora oibo."

content: Ar ze Isare dawat diye, hitare Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tũi zẽtte dũijjar otóba hazinnar hána goro, hẽtte tũwar bondu ba báiyaindore otóba egena gušṭire ba tuwangor ḍen gór bam góijjare dawat no diyo. Hen gorile oitofare hitara o tũware dawat dibo. Ar ei bafe tũwar dawat fũzi zaiboi.
Kintu tũi zẽtte hánar bebosta goro, hẽtte gorib, lula, anda edde ãtur, in okkolore ḍako.
Henot tũwar balai oibo, kiyollahoile tũware firai dibolla hitarattu kissu no takibo, forhesgar okkol morattu uwafes zinda oibar šomot hinor enam faiba."

content: Zara hána haito boišše hitarar butottu ekzone ei hota funi Isare hodde, "Hite hoto baggitta, ze Allar raijjot haito boibo."

content.text: "Doro, hono ekzon mainše ekkan ḍõr mela goijje. He melat bout mainšore dawat diya oiye.
Mela zehon oiye, hite hitar gulamore di dawat diyede manuš okkolore hoito defeṛaiye, 'Aio, ehon hár kissu tiyar oiye.'"
"Kintu hitara ekzonor bade ekzone beggune bahana deha šuru goijje. Foila ekzone hodde, 'Ãi kissu zobin kinni, ãttu zaire hin sagoi forer. Ãi dawatot zai no faridde hiyanolla maf sai.'
"Ar ekzone hodde, 'Ãi fãs zura bolod goru kinni, hinore bala horaf forikka goitto zair. Ãi dawatot zai no faridde hiyanolla maf sai.'
"Oinno ar ekzone hodde, 'Ãi biya goijji, hetolla ãi zai no farir.'

"Toi he gulam firi zai hitar malikore ei šob hota zanaiyegoi. Henot góror malike hitar gulamore rag gori hodde, 'Tui toratori šohoror rasta rasta edde goliye goliye za, gorib lula, anda, ãtur okkolore eṛe loi ai.'
"Hite giye edde malike zen zen hoiye hen hen goijje. Toi hite górot firi ai hodde, 'Huzur, kintu ehono kissu hána háibar zaga hali ase.'
"Henot malike gulamore hodde, 'Šohoror baire rasta rasta edde fõte fõte za, eṛe aibolla mainšore zurgor, zene ãr gór bori zagoi.'
Ãi tũwarare hoir, zarare dawat diya oiye hitarar butottu honokiye ãr ei melat hána hái no faribo."

content: Biššaši oite ki muillo diya fore
Bout manuš okkol Isar fũwati zat aššil. Isaye hitarar uzu muk firai hodde:

content.text: "Ze ãr hãse aiye hite zene nizor baf ma, bou fuwain edde bái boin, enki nizore foijjonto ãttuwaro hom adoijja boli mone gore. Hen no gorile hite ãr biššaši oi no fare.
Ze honokiye fotti din nizor duk hoštore bordaš gori ãr fise no aiye, hite ãr biššaši oi no fare.
"Tũwarar butore zodi honokiye ekkan usol gór banaito sa, toile hite age boi horosor hisab gori no saibo ne? Hite saibo hiyan bandi šeš gori farefan hitattu ṭĩya ase ne nai.
Kiyollahoile hite ṭuni gãri bade zodi bandi šeš gori no fare, toile ze mainše hiyan dekibo hitara beggune ṭaṭṭa uraibo.
Hitara hoibo, 'Manušwaye banda šuru goijje kintu šeš gori no fare.'
"Zodi ekzon razaye oinno ar ekzon raza loi zuddo gorito za, hite foila boi sinta goribo, kuri hazar šonnioye ãr loi zuddo goitto aiyer, šude doš hazar šoinno loi ki ãi hitarare tiya gorai fariyum?
Zodi hite hitar loi no fare toile hite oinno raza dure taite hitar loi šanti sukti goribolla manuš defeṛaibo.
"He bafe, tũwarar butore zodi honokiye bafi sinti hitar hár kissu sari no aiye, hen oile hite ãr biššaši oi no fare.
"Nun bala ziniš, kintu nunor moza zodi nošto oi zagoi, toile hin ken gori abar nun oibo?
Hetunot hin šude felai diya sara, zobinot fãš hisabe o ar bebar gora no zaibo.
"Zattu funibar han ase hite funok!"
